meta.project: Wetube - YouTube Clone Video Sharing Platform

product_overview: Wetube is a server-side rendered video sharing platform built with Flask, providing users features similar to YouTube including user authentication, video upload and management, viewing, social interactions, and administrative control.
core_goals: Enable seamless user authentication and profile management.
Provide robust video upload, editing, and management capabilities.
Support rich video viewing experience with views tracking and detailed information.
Implement interactive social features like comments, likes/dislikes, and subscriptions.
Offer efficient video browsing through search, filtering, and categorization.
Deliver insightful studio statistics for content creators.
Ensure secure and scalable RESTful API endpoints.
Facilitate efficient administration with comprehensive dashboard controls.
Support user experience improvements including dark mode and responsive design.
key_features: User Registration, Login, Logout, and Profile Management.
Video Upload with Thumbnail support, Edit and Delete functionality.
Video Playback with view count increment and detail display.
Video Browsing including listing, searching, sorting, and filtering by tags and categories.
Comment System with nested replies, likes/dislikes for comments.
Like and Dislike system for videos.
User Subscription management with subscription feeds.
User Profile pages showing user-specific video listings.
Studio Dashboard with rich video statistics like views and likes.
Video tagging and category based filters.
Administrator Dashboard for managing users, videos, comments, and database.
Secure file upload handling and validation.
Dark mode toggle for improved UI experience.
Responsive design to support multiple device screen sizes.
RESTful API for video, comment, like, and subscription operations.
Extensive unit test coverage (145 tests) for quality assurance.
user_flow_summary: User registers or logs in via authentication pages and manages their profile.
User uploads a new video with thumbnail and later can edit or delete their videos in the Studio area.
User browses the main page to search, filter, and view videos, can watch videos with real-time view count increment.
Users interact by posting comments, replying to comments, and liking or disliking both videos and comments.
Users subscribe and unsubscribe to other users and view subscription video feeds.
Content creators access their Studio Dashboard to review video statistics.
Administrators sign in to the admin dashboard to manage users, videos, comments, and the database.
Users toggle UI display modes between dark and light themes and enjoy responsive UI across devices.
validation_criteria: All authentication flows (signup, login, logout) function securely and correctly.
Video upload validates file type and size, supports thumbnail uploads, and correctly saves in storage.
Video editing and deletion functions update UI and backend consistently without data loss.
Video playback correctly increments view count and displays accurate video details.
Search, filtering, and sorting features return relevant and accurate video lists.
Comments support nested replies; users can add, edit, delete, and like/dislike comments properly.
Like/dislike mechanisms update counts reliably and prevent duplicate votes.
Subscription subscriptions and feeds are correctly reflected for the user.
Studio dashboard displays accurate video statistics from database data.
Admin dashboard offers full CRUD control over users, videos, comments, and database.
RESTful APIs respond with expected data formats and HTTP status codes.
UI dark mode toggle and responsive design adapt correctly across browsers and device types.
Security measures validate and sanitize file uploads to prevent vulnerabilities.
Unit tests cover critical code paths with a minimum of 90% code coverage.
